climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A region spanning the Murray River in Victoria and New South Wales, with almost all vineyards irrigated from the river. The wines are known as fruit driven and suited to short to medium-term cellaring.
